qualification_policy: Separate IDs/evidence for diagnostics and qualifications; no such runs count toward the proposed 60 experimental attempts.
why_needed: W3 gate requires exactly 1024 extra ASCII logical padding bytes on every adapter, with live sink/history preservation and an independent stored-payload check. The sink retains identity/timing only and FIWARE subscriptions select identity fields, so the payload-preserving evidence path must be shown to work rather than assumed.
vu_headroom_note: The pool is rate-derived. At 25/s: 25 x 5000 ms = 125 worst-case in-flight, plus 10% headroom, rounded to 150 VUs. That is exactly the B0 value, so this cell stays pool-identical to B0.

runs.gate: W3: exactly 1024 extra ASCII logical padding bytes via size_offset_bytes=1024 on every adapter, with live sink/history preservation and independent stored-payload validation, then 25/s for 300/600 s
runs.invalid_if: dropped_iterations > 0 (VU pool binds) or identity/capture mismatch
